caption: The drawing features two main objects on a beige background. The upper object is a circular, ornamented form rendered in grayscale pencil or ink. It has a textured, stippled center reminiscent of a shell or seed, surrounded by an irregular, looping band decorated with semi-oval shapes and bordered by a series of closely spaced vertical lines forming a ridged edge. Below this, centered on the page, is a simple outline side-view of a pedestal or stand, also in grayscale, with a flat top, a narrowing stem, and a wider base. The lower left corner includes a scale labeled in inches, while the lower right corner bears the name “F. CHOATE.” The entire composition is framed by a thin rectangular border.
title: Butter Mold
